title: Mari L NDE 3129
content: My heart stopped and I left my body through my head. I had no pain when I left my body. If you can't breathe you must came out from your body. But I was a new mother and wanted to see my little girl grown up. I don't wanted to die. I wanted to come back in my body and be with my newborn daughter. But I couldn't. I tried to go back in my body. I was drawing away with a force not of this world. I was locked out and couldn't of my own force go back into my body. I cried to God to let me live. I promised God to do things that I haven't done. I don't gave up. I tried again and again and again and again. Suddenly God let me go back. I was sucked or drawn back through my heart, not by my head as I had left my body. I had to help my heart to breath. I held onto attachment with my little girl. But I felt that if I died once more I couldn't came back again. I wanted to come to a mirror to see if I had a head. I saw light and heard noise on my right side when God let me come back to life and to my daughter. Thank You for listen to my testimony that we share. The true believer will desire to witness to what God has done for him/her. I am assured of God's presence and his love. God call people into closer walk with him. But Jesus said that blessed are they that have not seen and yet have believed in John. And God bless you abundantly.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Left the body through the head; reported no pain when leaving.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Felt 'drawing away with a force not of this world' and later 'sucked or drawn back through my heart'.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Returned when 'God let me go back'; felt 'sucked or drawn back through my heart' (after leaving through the head).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Force pulling away; crying to God; return through heart; light and noise on right side on return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with attempts to re-enter body; no described tunnel/realm; return attributed to God.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Repeated attempts to return to the body ('again and again and again and again').

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Left body through head; returned through heart. Reported being 'locked out' of the body and needing to 'help my heart to breath'. Wanted to look in a mirror to see if she had a head. Felt that if she died once more she could not come back again. Reported light and noise on the right side upon return.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “My heart stopped and I left my body through my head.” “I was drawing away with a force not of this world.” “I was locked out and couldn't of my own force go back into my body.” “Suddenly God let me go back. I was sucked or drawn back through my heart.” “I saw light and heard noise on my right side when God let me come back to life and to my daughter.”
